exposure: not consuming folic acid and iron supplements
cohort: 810 women with a mean age of 28.33 years (48.7% preterm) at an educational hospital over a seven-year period.
finding: Intercourse during the previous week, multiparity, short time from last delivery, preeclampsia, fetal anomaly, rupture of membranes, hypertension, and amniotic fluid leak were identified as risk factors for preterm labor.
mod_finding: Several factors, including history of cesarean section, were correlated with preterm labor.
